title: Potential outliers
explanation: Extreme observations are not necessarily errors.
recommendation: Review a box plot and original records.
risk: Deleting extremes can bias the data.

title: Missing values
recommendation: Review median or most-frequent imputation inside the training pipeline.
risk: No imputation strategy suits every dataset; whole-data imputation can leak validation information.

title: High cardinality / possible identifier
explanation: Nearly every record has a different label.
recommendation: Check whether this is an identifier before modeling.
risk: Removing a meaningful feature can reduce predictive value.

title: Infinite numeric values
explanation: Some numeric entries are infinite and cannot be used directly by the training pipeline.
recommendation: Review these rows. Preview replacing infinity with missing, then let training handle missing values inside its split.
risk: Infinity may carry domain meaning; review the original values before changing them.
